gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired BossRaid records. Kicking uses skill 500102, distinct from the same Japanese name in other encounters. Tribulation uses the Ricardo-specific status records. HARD HP, damage, SP floor, extra Book, cumulative 18-turn goal, and phase-specific mechanics are retained. Public English item and event names are cross-checked against the sources listed below.

lead.text: For 18 turns or less, maintain the Middle's Envy Absolute Resonance and carry unsealed Lævateinn damage into Phase 2. Protect key Sinners by choosing clash wins or Evade against attacks made dangerous by Book buildup.

listLead.text: A Middle team aiming for 18 cumulative turns or less. Covers Absolute Resonance, area attacks, and focused damage in Phase 2.

statNote.text: Base values for the Reflectrial encounter. Excludes dynamic buffs from Offense Level Up and Vengeance Tattoo. Second-phase HP carries over from the first phase; it is not a separate HP bar.

skillNote.text: Skills are listed separately for each phase. Check actual equipped skills rather than a fixed sequence. Conditional Unbreakable conversion from the Book is not included in the always-visible Coin icons.

projection.team.title.text: Six Middle members plus Evade and healing, continuing into Phase 2

projection.team.note.text: Uses at least four Middle members to change the opening pattern and Envy Absolute Resonance to strengthen Counters. Converting Counter into S3 requires a combined total of at least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance, distinct from ordinary 6 Envy Resonance. The starting order is an example; check the actual skill panel. Use Faust's Evade, Envy skills, and Envy E.G.O to maintain Resonance. The four reserve LCB Sinners are flexible slots and can be replaced by trained Identities of the same Sinners. Borrowed Support Identities cannot be used.

projection.team.members.0.reason.text: Main damage dealer. Progress sword unsealing with 6 Envy Absolute Resonance or S3, then damage Phase 2 with Lævateinn. Use normal S2 or S3 to clash with dangerous skills.

projection.team.members.1.reason.text: Supports the durability and SP of Middle members with defense equipped. Hits after their Counter ends can still Stagger them; do not force several attacks onto one recipient.

projection.team.members.2.reason.text: Counter attacker paired with Outis. Maintain 6 Envy Absolute Resonance to use S3 from defense.

projection.team.members.3.reason.text: Blunt Counter role enhanced by 6 Envy Absolute Resonance. Receives normal attacks they can survive.

projection.team.members.4.reason.text: Maintains Envy Resonance and uses Chains of Others when needed to weaken next turn's normal attacks. His own Counter gains Coin Power from Resonance but does not become S3.

projection.team.members.5.reason.text: Provides Envy Resonance and Counters. Do not also force them to handle strong area clashes.

projection.team.members.6.reason.text: Maintains Resonance with Envy Evade and heals with Fluid Sac. Blunt weakness makes failed Evades costly. Check SP and predictions; do not assign Promised Suffering while Evade Power is low.

projection.team.support.0.reason.text: Support passive unlocked at Uptie III. At 3 Envy Resonance, heals 3 HP to the ally with the lowest HP percentage and 3 SP to the ally with the lowest SP percentage.

projection.team.support.1.reason.text: Flexible Yi Sang slot. If reserves lack combat strength when deployed, replace with a trained Identity.

projection.team.support.2.reason.text: Flexible Hong Lu slot. Allocate Identities so those needed for a separate Phase 2 team are not used here.

projection.team.support.3.reason.text: Flexible Rodion slot. Can switch to a support passive for the Middle starters or an Identity that can fight after casualties.

projection.team.support.4.reason.text: Flexible Gregor slot. Prioritize starting-team Resonance and recovery over relying on reserve damage.

projection.team.egos.0.reason.text: HP and SP recovery. Costs 2 Lust, 4 Gloom, and 3 Envy. Opening SUPERBIA is an option. Its Gloom affinity may interrupt Envy Absolute Resonance; check whether 6 remains that turn.

projection.team.egos.1.reason.text: Costs 1 Sloth, 1 Gloom, and 2 Envy. On Hit, inflicts Bind and Attack Power Down next turn. Reduces normal attack damage, but alone cannot neutralize fixed or extra damage or ordinary Counters. Pride affinity can also break Resonance.

projection.team.egos.2.reason.text: Balances resource reserves while keeping Envy affinity. Costs 1 Lust and 3 Envy; converts resources on a clash win. An unopposed attack on a Staggered enemy does not trigger conversion.

projection.team.egos.3.reason.text: Envy clash option costing 1 Wrath and 4 Envy. On turns not needing Chains of Others, can maintain Absolute Resonance while answering dangerous skills.

projection.rules.0.text: A continuous battle with up to three team loadouts. Each has 7 starters and 5 reserves. Used Identities have reuse restrictions until progress is reset; borrowed Support Identities are unavailable.

projection.rules.1.text: You can save progress and switch loadouts before 12 turns with one team. Phase transitions also advance turns; manage the goal using the displayed cumulative count.

projection.rules.2.text: Phase transition and loadout replacement are separate. If the Middle core and healing remain, you do not have to replace the team automatically at 50% HP.

projection.rules.3.text: Sapling of Light usage is separate from normal battles and checked per difficulty. Do not assume it can be reused in the second phase of the same difficulty.

projection.rules.4.text: HARD gives +25% max HP and +20% skill damage. In Phase 2, enemy SP cannot fall below 0 and Sinners who attacked the body last turn gain 2 additional Book.

projection.rules.5.text: Reward tiers are clear, 30 turns or less, 24 or less, and 18 or less. The 18-turn tier gives 200 Lunacy and 300 Burnt-in Lens. Record a clear first; check progress reset and Identity allocation when improving time.

projection.budget.0.goal.text: Progress sword unsealing with 6 Envy Absolute Resonance or S3

projection.budget.0.adjustment.text: If healing or debuff E.G.O breaks Resonance, consider using Outis's available S3. Prioritize progressing the unsealing condition each turn.

projection.budget.1.goal.text: Turn the unsealed sword into damage and reach Phase 2 at 50% HP

projection.budget.1.adjustment.text: If not halfway by turn 9, review broken Resonance, whether Counters actually activate, and core levels or Stagger. This is an example allocation of 9 turns for each phase.

projection.budget.2.goal.text: Decide whether this team can finish or must hand over to the next

projection.budget.2.adjustment.text: Account for the per-loadout limit. If switching, prepare a Rupture / Gluttony team for Phase 2 without reusing spent Identities. If the Middle core remains alive, use its damage first.

projection.budget.3.goal.text: Kill the body rather than trying to eliminate every add

projection.budget.3.adjustment.text: Focus strong attacks during the 30% HP Stagger. Check whether excessive add cleanup is reducing damage on the body.

priorities.0.text: Unseal Outis's sword through six Middle members' Envy Absolute Resonance. Protect the core through Phase 2 and plan around 18 cumulative turns.

priorities.1.text: Win against COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!! and MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!! with strong skills. Handle Promised Suffering separately through Evade or other suitable defense.

priorities.2.text: Phase 2 at 50% HP; Stagger at 30%. Prioritize the body instead of spending actions killing every add.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: My key Sinners die despite winning clashes

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Check Book-based Unbreakable conversion and Promised Suffering's extra damage. Divide defensive reduction, Evade, and healing roles; avoid assigning nearly dead key Sinners to area clashes.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Counter does not become S3 or the sword stays sealed

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Counter conversion requires a combined total of at least 6 Envy Absolute Resonance. Isolated Envy skills do not count toward Absolute Resonance. When another affinity or a Staggered Sinner interrupts the chain, check the remaining consecutive groups and their combined count. Meursault's Counter does not become S3.

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Allocate 9 turns to reach 50% HP and 9 more for Phase 2, then identify the slower half. Review sword unsealing, unused Counters, core Stagger, and excess add damage. Judge current HP and skills rather than forcing a fixed turn-by-turn sequence.

troubleshooting.3.symptom.text: Not enough resources for Fluid Sac or Chains of Others

troubleshooting.3.advice.text: You need Lust, Gloom, and Sloth as well as Envy. Use Absolute Resonance's extra resources and Outis's I'll Go fer Scissors. How 'Bout You? to save costs for the next heal or debuff.

units.0.notes.0.text: At 50% HP or less, enters Phase 2. Unlike 5-30, halving HP does not win.

units.0.notes.1.text: All physical resistances are neutral. Do not apply the story version's Blunt weakness.

units.0.notes.2.text: Per-turn Offense Level Up and Vengeance Tattoo add separately to displayed base levels.

units.1.notes.0.text: Win by reducing HP to 0. Killing every add is unnecessary.

units.1.notes.1.text: Transition removes effects other than Ricardo's unique effects. Do not plan to carry over accumulated Rupture or other Phase 1 statuses.

units.1.notes.2.text: Tribulation prevents SP from falling below 0. Do not make sustained Sinking SP loss the Phase 2 win condition.

units.2.notes.0.text: Add summoned in Phase 2. Victory requires Ricardo's defeat.

units.2.notes.1.text: Full add skill values are not listed. Use battle predictions and answer only attacks that threaten key Sinners.

passives.0.effect.text: At 10 or more clash exchanges against the same target, Clash Power increases or decreases according to exchanges ÷10, rounded down. Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking are capped at 30 Potency and 10 Count.

passives.0.response.text: Do not assume normal stacking caps. After reaching 30 Potency, improve skill damage rather than spending all actions on further application.

passives.1.effect.text: Gain Offense Level Up equal to the current turn number.

passives.1.response.text: Clashes grow harder over time. Check actual predictions and remaining turns rather than displayed Power alone.

passives.2.condition.text: Turn Start, taking damage, and attack hits

passives.2.effect.text: At Turn Start, inflict 1 Written in the Book on all enemies. On taking damage, inflict 2 on the attacker. On hitting, remove 1 from the target. During battle, gain Vengeance Tattoo equal to the amount removed.

passives.2.response.text: Key attackers also build more Book. Check Stack and HP each turn; do not keep assigning every strong attack to the same Sinner.

passives.3.name.text: Don't Resist and Accept Your Punishments

passives.3.condition.text: Target has a Defense Skill equipped

passives.3.effect.text: At Combat Start, deal 30% less damage to that target.

passives.3.response.text: Works well with Middle Counters. However, do not assume this makes Promised Suffering's extra damage or unbroken-hit percentage damage safe.

passives.4.condition.text: On Skill Use and related triggers

passives.4.effect.text: At 20 or more Written in the Book on the target, all Coins of that skill become Unbreakable. If Ricardo selects the target with the highest Book, the attack cannot be redirected.

passives.4.response.text: From 20 Book, even normal skills retaliate after a clash win. If an attack is marked unredirectable, handle it with the assigned recipient's clash, Evade, or durability rather than assuming another ally can intercept.

passives.5.name.text: You're The Middle's Priority Revenge Target

passives.5.condition.text: Turn Start with a target at 30 Written in the Book

passives.5.effect.text: Create an extra skill slot and use IMMEDIATE, COMPLETE, AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!

passives.5.response.text: 30 Book signals an extra attack. Win the clash to prevent its unbroken-hit percentage damage.

passives.6.effect.text: From turn 2, heal all allies including self for 10 SP. Damage taken from Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, and Sinking −20%.

passives.6.response.text: Use strengthened attacks and focused Stagger damage rather than relying only on flat status damage.

passives.7.response.text: Before crossing 50% HP, decide whether the team will continue or be replaced for Phase 2.

phases.1.steps.3.text: Chains of Others weakens next turn's normal attacks. Assign roles while accounting for Resonance interruption that turn and Meursault's own next-turn debuffs.

phases.2.title.text: Keep the strengthened Middle core and focus the Phase 2 body

phases.2.steps.0.text: Phase 2's Shade shifts toward Rupture and Gluttony, but Envy weakness remains. If the Middle core with its unsealed sword is alive, a change in favored effects alone is no reason to switch.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Transition removes all effects except the body's unique effects. Reapply needed debuffs instead of assuming Phase 1 statuses carry over.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Phase 2 Tribulation adds 2 Book to Sinners who attacked the body last turn and keeps enemy SP at 0 or above. Do not switch to a strategy relying on indefinitely lowering SP through Sinking.

phases.2.steps.3.text: Assemble summons more adds. Stop only attacks threatening key Sinners and keep strong attacks' main targets on the body.

phases.3.title.text: Focus damage during Stagger; switch to unused Identities if necessary

phases.3.steps.0.text: Concentrate strong S2 and S3 attacks during the 30% HP Stagger. In Phase 2, if the attacker is faster than the Staggered body, it also takes +(Speed difference ×2)% damage, up to 20%.

phases.3.steps.1.text: A normal Counter deals no damage when the Staggered enemy does not attack. Use Attack Skills and maintain Envy Absolute Resonance where possible.

phases.3.steps.2.text: If one loadout cannot finish within 12 turns, use an unused Rupture / Gluttony team for Phase 2. H Corp. members also gain +15% damage dealt and −30% damage taken, but do not choose untrained Identities solely for affiliation.

phases.3.steps.3.text: The 18-turn goal is cumulative. Keep finishing attacks on the body rather than diverting them to adds.

warnings.0.text: 5-30's Ishmael survival condition and victory at 50% HP do not apply.

warnings.1.text: 20 Book enables all-Unbreakable normal skills; 30 adds IMMEDIATE, COMPLETE, AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION! Promised Suffering's conversion starts at 3, and No More Tests at 5.

warnings.2.text: Check the actual skill display for unredirectable attacks. Below 30 Book does not automatically mean it can be intercepted.

warnings.3.text: IMMEDIATE, COMPLETE, AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!'s percentage damage requires an unbroken hit. Breaking Coins prevents it, but does not remove normal damage from Unbreakable Coins remaining at 20 or more Book.

warnings.4.text: Do not have everyone Counter an unsurvivable area attack just to create Absolute Resonance. Extra hits after a Counter can still Stagger them.

warnings.5.text: Bleed, Rupture, and similar effects are capped at 30 Potency and 10 Count. Do not plan a prolonged fight around normal caps.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Maximum 30. Damage taken +3% per Stack. Increases at Turn Start and when attacking the body; decreases from the body's hits and certain skills.

mechanics.0.response.text: Check remaining HP and enemy skills alongside Stack. You do not need to take unbroken-hit percentage damage just to reduce it.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Maximum 300. Ricardo's skill Offense Level +1 per 10 Stack. Increases by the amount of Book Ricardo removes.

mechanics.1.response.text: Enemy Offense Level also rises over time. Base Power tables alone cannot determine clash chances.

mechanics.2.effect.text: Deploying at least four Middle members changes the first two patterns and grants +2 resources of every affinity. The body's skill effects do not apply Paralyze to units with defense equipped. Attacks that inflict Bleed or special Bleed, or have Envy affinity, deal +30% damage, or +100% for E.G.O. Absolute Resonance grants one resource of a lowest-reserve affinity four times.

mechanics.2.response.text: Build around Middle defense and Envy Resonance. The bonus checks individual Attack Skills, not a broad classification as a Bleed Identity.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Attacks inflicting Rupture or using Gluttony deal +25% damage, or +100% for E.G.O. H Corp. members deal +15% damage and take −30%. Absolute Resonance grants one resource of a lowest-reserve affinity four times. If the attacker is faster than the Staggered body, damage taken increases by Speed difference ×2%, up to 20%.

mechanics.3.response.text: Either continue with the trained Middle core or switch to an unused Rupture / Gluttony team. Exploit the Speed difference during focused attacks after Stagger.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Max HP +25%, skill damage +20%. In Phase 2, Ricardo and Little Brothers cannot fall below 0 SP; at Turn Start, inflict 2 extra Book on units that attacked the body last turn.

mechanics.4.response.text: HP and buildup are heavier than NORMAL. Protect the Middle core and concentrate damage after unsealing and during Stagger.

preparation.0.text: For an 18-turn goal, build key Sinners from Lv. 60 upward toward the available cap. Bring the Middle core to Uptie IV and healing / clash E.G.O to the needed Threadspin.

preparation.1.text: The main starting lineup is six Middle members plus Faust. Prioritize Outis, Heathcliff, and Ishmael while combining the Nursefather’s sword unsealing with 6 Envy Absolute Resonance.

preparation.2.text: Put Faust with Fluid Sac and Meursault with Chains of Others in the same team. Account for Resonance breaks from E.G.O affinities and resource costs.

preparation.3.text: Without the Middle roster, Phase 1 Bleed and Phase 2 Rupture or Heishou are alternatives. They may not reproduce the main setup's procedure or turn count. Allocate each team's core in advance.

roles.0.name.text: Clash recipient for dangerous area skills

roles.0.reason.text: Use strong E.G.O or a core S3 against COMPLETE AND TOTAL EXTERMINATION!!! and MY HAIR COUPOOOOOOOOOOONS!!! Envy options preserve Resonance more easily, but prioritize survival if the clash chance is insufficient.

roles.1.reason.text: Targets high Book, so prepare Evade, Clashable Defense, and healing. Ensure the target can respond even if redirection is locked; avoid forcing low-SP Evade or Blunt-weak Sinners into it.

roles.2.reason.text: Restore HP before the next hit. Use Absolute Resonance's extra resources and conversion so excess Envy does not leave you unable to heal.
